name: Gaius (from Derbe)
title: Paul's traveling companion from Derbe
summary: Gaius of Derbe was one of Paul's faithful companions who accompanied him on his third missionary journey. He was part of the group that escorted Paul from Greece back to Jerusalem with the collection for the poor Christians there.

keyEvents.title: Traveling companion of Paul
keyEvents.description: Gaius of Derbe was among those who accompanied Paul from Greece through Macedonia on the way to Jerusalem. He was part of a group of representatives from various congregations.

keyEvents.title: Bearer of the Churches' Gift
keyEvents.description: As a representative of the churches in the Galatia region, Gaius helped deliver the collected gift to the poor Christians in Jerusalem, an important act of Christian solidarity.

keyEvents.title: Waited for Paul in Troas
keyEvents.description: Gaius and the other traveling companions went ahead and waited for Paul in Troas, where they spent seven days with the church there.
